verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26448321 from Guangzhou PackRight Packaging Co., Ltd. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318677 dated 2026-06-15. It has one line: item 00010, PR-CC-0312 Game Card Case (clear), 80,000 units at 1.44 CNY each, confirmed for 2026-08-12. Terms are FOB Yantian and NET30. The document has no handwriting, corrections or stamps.
observations: Single-page printed document with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
No document date is printed; only the referenced PO date (2026-06-15) and the confirmed delivery date (2026-08-12) appear.
No total price, unit of measure for quantity, or price basis (per piece or per 1,000) is stated.
The Chinese header text (订单确认书) means 'Order Confirmation'.
